name: Required Learning Completion
description: Completed / assigned learning items.

name: Training Start Rate
description: Distinct started / assigned learners.

name: On-Time Training Completion
description: On-time completed / due assignments.

name: AI Skill Assessment Completion
description: Completed / assigned learner-assessment pairs; completion is not passing.

name: AI Skill Level Gain
description: Requires comparable measured pre/post results. No result is inferred from a checkbox.

name: Copilot Seat Activation Rate
description: Assigned seats with activity / assigned seats.

name: 28-Day AI-Active Rate
description: AI-active / eligible licensed users in the 28-day window.

name: Regular Copilot Use Score
description: 100 × min(active days, 8) / 8; eight-day target is sample policy only.

name: Sustained Weekly Copilot Use Rate
description: User-weeks with at least two active days / eligible user-weeks.

name: Copilot Agent Adoption Rate
description: IDE-agent users / AI-active users.

name: Merged PR Throughput
description: Distinct PRs merged to configured mainline.

name: Median Merged PRs per Active Week
description: Median merges per commit-active user-week, including zero-merge active weeks. Sample reference: 4.

name: Median PR Life-Cycle Time
description: PR-open to merge elapsed hours. Sample reference: 24 hours.

name: Median Time to First Human Review
description: PR-open to first human review. Sample reference: 6 hours.

name: Orphaned PR Rate
description: Open non-draft PRs stale more than 30 days / open non-drafts.

name: Median Development Preparation Time
description: Earliest linked commit to PR-open elapsed time, not active labor. Sample reference: 9 hours.

name: Median Review Cycles
description: Governed cycles per reviewed closed/merged PR. Sample reference: 1.5 cycles.

name: Median Author Rework Time
description: Change-request to author-response time. Sample reference: 4.5 hours.

name: Copilot Code Acceptance Rate
description: Acceptance / compatible generation activity counts; anomalies are not capped.

name: AI Credits per AI-Active User
description: Scoped credits / AI-active users; own total in self view.

name: CI First-Pass Score
description: First submission, complete nonempty required checks, attempt 1, initial head >5 changed lines.

name: Revert-Free Score
description: Unreverted / mature delivered authored commits; 30-day maturity.

name: Review Rework-Free Score
description: Eligible reviewed merged PRs without valid non-dismissed human change requests.

name: PR Life-Cycle Speed Score
description: 100 × approved same-scope baseline / current lifecycle median, capped at 100.

name: Mainline Completion Score
description: Mature eligible non-reverted commits delivered within seven days.
